name: What materials are needed for drywall taping and mudding?

mainEntity.name: What materials are needed for drywall taping and mudding?

acceptedAnswer.text: The essential materials include drywall joint tape (paper or fiberglass mesh), joint compound (also known as mud), and appropriate tools. Joint compound comes in different types, such as setting-type (quick-drying) and drying-type (all-purpose, lightweight). Tools required typically include taping knives of various widths, a mud pan, a sanding pole or hand sander with sandpaper, and a utility knife. Depending on the project, corner tools, hawk and trowel, and dust masks are also necessary.
acceptedAnswer.description: Key materials are joint tape, joint compound, and tools like taping knives, a mud pan, and sanders.
